task: Stop the DONE delivery-check freshness gate from re-staling a freshly-signed delivery-check on unrelated whole-tree materialHash drift, by folding a signed storyFilesHash into delivery-check and downgrading pure whole-tree drift to a mandatory re-attestation advisory.
outcome: An operator finishing a story after an unrelated main merge runs `lattice story_advance '{"storyId":"B-xxxx","phase":"DONE"}'` and, instead of being blocked by `[✗] delivery-check: stale delivery-check: materialHash mismatch (recorded …, current …)`, sees `[✓] delivery-check: N docsPromises checked — ADVISORY: whole-tree materialHash drift detected while the signed delivery-check storyFilesHash matches; the story diff the reviewer attested is unchanged. Re-attestation advisory: re-run the lattice-review-delivery reviewer if the merged-in (non-story) code could affect the real-machine test claims.` and the story proceeds to DONE without a forced reviewer re-sign. If the operator instead changed a story-owned file, the row still fails: `[✗] delivery-check: stale delivery-check: materialHash mismatch …`.
facts: evaluateDeliveryCheckFreshness (core/delivery-check-hash.ts:135-143) hard-fails on any materialHash mismatch today; done-oracle.ts:592 renders that as a blocking DONE row.

The storyFilesHash secondary-freshness signal (decision story-files-hash-material-drift) already downgrades whole-tree drift to an advisory for review runs, verification evidence, and escalation verdicts, but NOT for delivery-check.
DeliveryCheckData has no storyFilesHash field and signDeliveryCheck does not sign one (core/types.ts:1395-1416, core/delivery-check-hash.ts:34-52).
currentStoryFilesHash(gitCwd,'HEAD',metadataRoot) (core/evidence-freshness.ts:199) is the existing, tested computation to reuse.

A red→green spike already proved the fix: non-story whole-tree drift -> advisory, story-owned change -> stale reject, forged storyFilesHash -> tampered (verified diff at /tmp/friction1-cfresh-fix/core-fix.diff).
constraints: delivery-check is SIGNED: storyFilesHash must be folded into signDeliveryCheck/recomputeDeliveryCheckHash so the downgrade keyed on it is non-forgeable (a forged storyFilesHash must break _hash).
Downgrade only ever relaxes to a MANDATORY loud advisory (code delivery_check_drift_advisory), never to 'fresh', and never rebinds the stored hash.
A missing storyFilesHash (legacy) or a storyFilesHash mismatch (story-owned change) keeps the strict stale_delivery_check behavior.
Gate A (completed-snapshot, done-oracle.ts:140) stays strict — it is a frozen-ref integrity check where storyFilesHash is dead code; only add a keep-strict note.
Gate B (done-required suite) stays strict and keeps re-running on the merged tree — out of scope.
Legacy delivery-check records without storyFilesHash must recompute byte-identically (append-only signature payload).
unknowns: The exact advisory wording to surface on the DONE row (must be loud and direct re-attestation) — to be finalized in CHK-003.
Whether the existing delivery-check-freshness smoke's all-on-main fixture needs a full story-branch rewrite or an added story-branch case (CHK-004).
